hook: Same 154 kW. Same 3.5-tonne tow rating. Kia's controversial newcomer vs Australia's best-seller.

stories.a: The styling split the internet, but it carries more, sits higher and uses less fuel on paper.
stories.b: Australia's favourite ute brings 60 Nm more torque and a $5k smaller sticker.
stories.take: Spec sheet says Kia. Sales charts say Ford.

_sources: 4X4 Australia 'Kia Tasman X-Pro vs Ford Ranger Wildtrak' (7 Sep 2025) specs table: Tasman X-Pro 2.2 diesel 154 kW, 440 Nm, payload 1013 kg, ADR 8.1 L/100km, 252 mm clearance, 3500 kg towing, $74,990 +ORC; Ranger Wildtrak 2.0 bi-turbo 154 kW, 500 Nm, payload 985 kg, ADR 8.7 L/100km, 234 mm clearance, 3500 kg towing, $69,890 +ORC
CarExpert '2025 Kia Tasman review' (1 Aug 2025) and CarsGuide Tasman X-Pro off-road test (12 Oct 2025): confirm 154 kW/440 Nm, 3500 kg, 1013 kg payload, 8.1 L/100km, $74,990
Prices are 2025 launch-era list prices before on-roads
